sprint.title: Sprint 188 — Ship, then make the Subscription app whole
sprint.focus: Derek chose 2026-09-07 (decision #1814): (a) ship the merged Sprint 187 build (OODS-pro cd8ee986) to the live PM2 bridge, which still serves pre-Sprint-183 code at 8ce34907, adopt the authentic User-form successor with backup and rollback, resolve the served schema/load 400 and send the one combined reconnect to aquex-mcp and forge-demos (closes #1374/#1379/#1384); (b) generate from the public object/context inputs alone a runnable Subscription application in React and Vue — list, detail, edit, cancel, timeline — with loading/empty/error/success on every screen and Forge-generated navigation, store and sample data, and give the Subscription screens the eight Billable/Archivable rows their traits declare (BillingSummaryBadge, BillingAmountInput, BillingIntervalSelector, CycleProgressCard, PaymentTimeline, PaymentEventTimeline, BillingCardMeta, ArchivedRowOverlay) implemented from the trait declarations to the Sprint 185 bar. Six serial missions: m01 ship; m02 workflow context + application emitters; m03 the app live in both frameworks with 32 state observations and craft screenshots; m04 list/form billing rows; m05 detail/timeline/card/archive rows + nucleus catalog truth + /health revision; m06 census 66/66 + workflow, one four-suite capture, sprint-wide advertised diff, review handoff. App before rows on purpose so a session cut after m03 still leaves a working app. Exit: the program sentence met for Subscription in both frameworks; criterion 8 opened; 'usable' decided by the independent review's craft inspection. Pace rule in force: no per-mission captures, no new closeout apparatus, no critic. Build fresh from cmos/planning/forge-s188-subscription-workflow-decision-memo.md in ~/.codex/worktrees/s188/OODS-Forge (codex/sprint-188-subscription-workflow from cd8ee986); builder does not self-certify.
